reasoning: The glyph shows a circle overlaid with a curved horizontal band, standard in camera UIs for panorama/360 mode and also resembling a head wearing a VR visor. Because it lacks internal detail, most viewers outside a camera UI will struggle to tell whether it means panorama, VR goggles, a ringed planet, or a transit roundel.
